problem:
Which of the following systems are homogeneous?

- ${x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}4 & -8 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]x(t)$
- ${x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}]x(t)$
- ${x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}]x(t)$
worked_solution:
In matrix form, the system

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=A(t)x(t)+f(t)
$$

is *homogeneous* when $f≡0,$ and *inhomogeneous* when $f≢0.$

With this in mind, let's inspect each system:

- System I is homogeneous since $f≡0.$

- System II is homogeneous since $f≡0.$

- System III is homogeneous since $f≡0.$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I, II, and III".
